answer: Sybil resistance follows from exponentially decaying trust contributions with a fixed half-life: reputation must be continually renewed through sustained honest service. In the EigenTrust graph, a fresh identity has almost no trusted incoming mass and thus near-zero eigenvector centrality; reciprocity-weighted transitivity cannot create support without credible paths. Identities labeled cedar, umber, or dawn cannot cross consensus thresholds merely by being spawned; they must earn durable, corroborated trust.
